name: onehuman-engine
description: The OneHuman engine — AI-agent detection inside signed-in sessions, per-resource policy (allow · mask · step-up · block), hash-chained audit log and Ed25519-signed decision proofs. You do not install this directly: `npm i onehuman` (Apache-2.0) depends on it and is the API you use.
